description: Series bucket-size vectors. The allowed set is a fixed spec enum (openapi.yaml: SeriesParams.bucket enum ['1m','5m','1h','1d','1w','1mo']). Every client SDK validates `bucket` against this set locally BEFORE issuing the request and raises its native validation error (the taxonomy 'validation' type) on a miss. Plan-gating of finer buckets stays server-side (clients cannot know the plan), so a syntactically-valid bucket may still be rejected by the server with a 403 — that is an 'api' error, not covered here. Loader contract: every value in `valid` must pass client-side bucket validation; every value in `invalid` must be rejected client-side. Matching is exact and case-sensitive; no trimming.
